address: EN 4 KM 136.4 - Herdade das Servas, Estremoz, 7100 600, Portugal
bio: A restaurant located on the outskirts of Estremoz, on a wine estate (Herdade das Servas) surrounded by vineyards that have been owned by the Serrano Mira family for 13 generations and date back to 1667. The dining space, which is full of character thanks to its vaulted ceiling and fireplace, is keen to combine Alentejan cuisine with touches of modernity. Typical dishes on the menu here include partridge escabeche, dried figs and toasted Alentejo bread; wild boar with rice and mushrooms; and deconstructed cod “à brás” with “molecular” olives. Added bonuses are the pleasant terrace and wines produced on the estate (Herdade das Servas and Casa da Tapada)....
